description: Rago catalog seed for Scribase (backend cloud). Scribase's own billing (flat price per environment with hard caps and capacity packs) stays authoritative; this catalog receives the optional usage mirror the Scribase control plane posts from its meter pass when SCRIBASE_RAGO_URL and SCRIBASE_RAGO_API_KEY are set (crates/control-api/src/adapters/rago_usage.rs). One Rago subscription per Scribase environment, external id `scribase_{organization_id}_{project_id}_{environment_id}` by default (SCRIBASE_RAGO_SUBSCRIPTION_TEMPLATE). Every event carries `properties.value` as a decimal string plus organization_id, project_id and environment_id.

billable_metrics.name: Scribase Database Size (GB)
billable_metrics.description: Hourly sample of the environment's Postgres database size in GB. Peak over the period.

billable_metrics.name: Scribase File Storage (GB)
billable_metrics.description: Hourly sample of the environment's file storage in GB. Peak over the period.

billable_metrics.name: Scribase Backup Storage (GB)
billable_metrics.description: Hourly sample of pending and available backup bytes in GB. Peak over the period.

billable_metrics.name: Scribase Egress (GB)
billable_metrics.description: Increment of response bytes (GB) the data-plane log shipper reported since the last mirrored mark. Summed.

billable_metrics.name: Scribase Compute Hours
billable_metrics.description: Increment of hours the environment spent ready since the last mirrored mark. Summed.

billable_metrics.name: Scribase Function Invocations
billable_metrics.description: Increment of edge-function requests the gateway forwarded since the last mirrored mark. Summed.

plans.name: Scribase Usage Mirror
plans.description: Metering mirror at $0: every charge is zero-priced, so Rago records Scribase usage without invoicing it. Scribase's flat per-environment price (collected through its own billing provider) is the charge of record. Price the charges only if an operator moves Scribase billing onto Rago.

sample_events.note: POST /events { event: { transaction_id: 'scribase:<subscription>:database_gb:h<hour epoch>', external_subscription_id: 'scribase_<org>_<project>_<env>', code: 'scribase_database_gb', timestamp, properties: { value: '0.250000', organization_id, project_id, environment_id } } }. At most one per hour per environment.

POST /events { event: { transaction_id: 'scribase:<subscription>:egress_gb:p<period epoch>:<from>-<to>', external_subscription_id, code: 'scribase_egress_gb', timestamp, properties: { value: '<to - from>', ... } } }. Replays of the same increment are dropped by Rago as duplicates.
